campus_notes: Compiled 2026-09-14 from University of Delaware Residence Life & Housing's official hall directory. Delaware publishes the exact room types each hall or complex offers but states that with the variety of room types on campus it cannot give exact measurements for every room, so every room here uses the site's estimate fallback and is labelled "Estimated based on similar rooms. Official size not published." Suites and apartments are modeled per bedroom so occupant counts and layouts match cleanly. Beds are Twin XL.
